Name: Maggs Alex Friendship Expansion Dialogue and Events
Author: MaggPlays
Description:
Follow me on the socials for current updates, what I'm planning, or just general shenanigans! [url=https://www.tumblr.com/blog/maggplays]Tumblr[/url] | [url=https://bsky.app/profile/maggplays.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url]
My mods are free and always will be free, but if you enjoy them, consider buying me a coffee on [url=https://ko-fi.com/maggplays]Ko-fi[/url]!

[b][color=#6aa84f][size=4]Quick Links[/size][/color][/b]
Looking for the Romance version? Here it is! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31506]Magg's Immersive Alex Romance Spicy/Sweet[/url]

[b][color=#6aa84f][size=4]IMPORTANT!! Installation[/size][/color][/b]
Download the zip file, then unzip it to your mods folder. See SMAPI for more help if needed.
Updating: delete the old Magg’s folder in your mods folder, then unzip the new version to your mods folder.

[color=#6aa84f][size=4][b]Overview[/b][/size][/color]
Friendship dialogue and event expansion for Alex, adding character depth and WAY more lines and events up to 8 hearts.
Alex's friendship with the farmer grows with his heart levels as he matures and changes, becoming more self-aware and open to new possibilities. His close family connections and building relationships with other people his age are major themes during the first year.
[b]Note:[/b] this version of Alex is less one-dimensional than most Alex mods, he has more interests than just gridball, though gridball is still his favorite topic. All additional content is based on vanilla hints and various character lines.

[color=#6aa84f][size=4][b]Features[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Nearly a full replacement of Alex's vanilla dialogue along with a massive expansion up to 8 hearts. Includes unique dialogue for Alex nearly every day the first year.
[*]Unique dialogue for festivals for the first 2 years, updated lines for events like Green Rain, Ginger Island, Community Center, etc.
[*]Randomized rain and animation dialogue based on heart level.
[*]18 new events plus updates to vanilla events.
[*]Alex keeps his vanilla pronouns/identity, this will not be changed.
[/list]
[b][color=#6aa84f][size=4]Event List[/size][/color][/b]
Quick list of major heart events and triggers:
[spoiler]
[b][color=#e06666]1 Heart[/color][/b]
[b]Smooth Operator[/b]: Town, spring 10 - 20 (event can trigger on any of these days), 10 am - 2 pm

[b][color=#e06666]2 Hearts[/color][/b]
[b]Vanilla[/b]: Beach when Alex is present (this mod updates Alex's schedule so he does go to the beach in spring)
[b]Downtime[/b]: unlocks 7 days after seeing Vanilla 2-heart, Beach, not raining, 10 am - 2 pm
[b]Sous Chef[/b]: Alex's house, noon - 4 pm

[b][color=#e06666]3 Hearts[/color][/b]
[b]Leveling Up[/b]: must have seen Sous Chef, 3 hearts with Alex, 2 hearts with Sebastian, Sam, and Abigail, Town, not rainy, 10 am - 3 pm
[b]Writer's Block[/b]: must have seen Leveling Up, Saloon, after 4 pm

[b][color=#e06666]4 Hearts[/color][/b]
[b]Vanilla[/b]: Town, 9 am to 4 pm
[b]All-Star Chef[/b]: have seen Vanilla 4-heart event, Alex's house, noon to 4 pm
[b]Extra Ticket[/b]: unlocks 7 days after seeing All-Star Chef, Farm, not rainy, 6 - 8 am
[b]Ballgame[/b]: must have seen Extra Ticket, Bus Stop, 4 - 6 pm

[b][color=#e06666]5 hearts[/color][/b]
[b]Vanilla[/b]: Alex's house when he's home
[b]Puppy Love[/b]: unlocks 4 days after seeing vanilla 5-heart event, Town, not rainy, noon - 4 pm

[b][color=#e06666]6 Hearts[/color][/b]
[b]Vanilla[/b]: Alex's house when he's home
[b]Better Together[/b]: unlocks 5 days after seeing Vanilla 6-heart event, Alex's house after 4 pm (must have Alex's Custom Sprites enabled)
[b]Longshot part 1[/b]: unlocks 10 days after seeing Vanilla 6-heart event, Alex's house, noon - 4 pm
[b]Longshot part 2[/b]: unlocks the day after seeing Longshot part 1, Beach, sunny, 7 am - 5 pm

[b][color=#e06666]7 Hearts[/color][/b]
[b]Past Ghosts[/b]: unlocks 6 days after seeing Longshot part 2, Alex's house, not rainy, 10 am - 6 pm

[b][color=#e06666]8 Hearts[/color][/b]
[b]Vanilla[/b]: Beach, sunny, when Alex is there
[b]Off the Leash[/b]: have seen Vanilla 8-heart event, Farm, not rainy, 6 am - noon
[b]Ace Serve[/b]: unlocks 5 days after seeing Off the Leash, Beach, not rainy, not winter, 11 am - 4 pm
[b]Upgrade[/b]: unlocks 5 days after seeing Ace Serve, Alex's house after 2 pm

[size=3][color=#e06666][b]Special Events[/b] [/color][/size](not based on heart level)
[b]Game Day[/b]: Last 2 weeks of every season, Alex's house, 3 - 8 pm
[b]Winter Walk[/b]: Kicks off the last week of fall at Alex's house, repeating morning walk with Alex. Set the frequency in the config menu.
[/spoiler]

[b][color=#6aa84f][size=4]Config Menu Options[/size][/color][/b]
[b]Farmer neutral pronouns[/b]
Select 'Yes' to use gender neutral pronouns for farmer.

[b]Alex's grandparent names[/b]
Select your preference for what Alex calls his grandparents (compatible with DSV)

[b]Winter walk with Alex[/b]
Choose whether you take a walk with Alex in the mornings in winter, a repeating mini-event with randomized conversation.
Options: Saturdays, 3 Days a Week, Daily, None

[b]Vanilla portrait edit[/b]
Enable a minor change in Alex's vanilla portraits related to the story. Select 'No' if you have a portrait mod installed.

[b]Fluffy hair sprites[/b]
Enable slightly modified vanilla sprites for Alex with hair that better matches his portrait. Select 'No' if you have another sprite mod installed.

[b]Alex custom sprites[/b]
Select 'Yes' to enable Alex's custom sprites for a few small events.

[b]Dusty custom sprite[/b]
Select 'Yes' to replace Dusty's sprite with the one from the events in this mod. Does not work if SVE is installed. NOTE: The event sprite cannot be changed since there is no vanilla Dusty overworld sprite.

[b]Alex's house sprites[/b]
Makes edits to Alex's bedroom and living room, adding decor from the story. Compatible with SVE. Set to 'no' if you're using another texture mod and the edits conflict.

[b]Outdoor decor[/b]
Set to 'no' to turn off custom outdoor decor related to events.

[b][color=#6aa84f][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/color][/b]
Compatible with most mods, including SVE.
Highly recommended to use MH Event List to help track events.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39885]MH Event List[/url]﻿ Functions like Event Lookup, but includes many more features and shows the time gaps between events

[b][color=#6aa84f][size=4]Permissions[/size][/color][/b]
Do NOT copy and re-post this mod elsewhere without requesting permission. I worked heckin’ hard on this mod, it’s my baby and I would hate to see it uploaded by someone who didn’t do the work.
[b]Translation: [/b]Please message me to let me know you want to translate. I will tell you if anyone else has already started a transltion in your language and answer any questions you might have.
[b]Modders:[/b] You may use this file as an example of 1.6 code formatting as a reference only, do not copy my dialogue. If you have questions, feel free to message me.
[b]Streamers:[/b] Feel free to stream this mod, just add a link back here for download and credit.
